 Updated 6:05 a.m. Eastern on November 13, 2026 
 Claude says a fix has been deployed for the issue affecting its services, and it is monitoring for recovery.
 What is affected
 The incident lists elevated errors on claude.ai, Claude Code and platform.claude.com, with authentication issues confirmed for Claude.ai and Claude Code.
 Official update timeline
 4:58 a.m. Eastern on November 13, 2026 , marked Investigating
 We are investigating an issue with users authenticating to Claude.ai and Claude Code. We will provide an update as soon as possible.
 6:05 a.m. Eastern on November 13, 2026 , marked Monitoring
 A fix has been deployed for the issue affecting Claude services and we are monitoring for recovery.
